summary: Full frontend regression after CRA -> Next.js (App Router + TS) migration and MITS logo swap. All 12 routes render (200 for real pages, 404 for the intended not-found route and unknown slugs). Header logo (data-testid=header-logo) renders inside white chip and links to '/'. Header transparent at top and switches to white/blur+shadow class after ~24px scroll. All 7 desktop nav links navigate to correct routes. Mobile menu (data-testid=mobile-menu-button) opens slide-in nav with all links. Contact form: client-side validation errors appear for full_name/email/phone/message; valid submission POSTs to https://mits-stage.preview.emergentagent.com/api/contact with full_name (snake_case) body, returns 200, and shows data-testid=contact-success. Backend seed test via curl also returns {success:true}. Framer Motion reveal animations fire on scroll (0 stuck opacity-0 text elements after scrolling full page). Footer renders logo chip and Company/Solutions/Contact link groups. Cookie consent banner (data-testid=cookie-consent-banner) appears when consent cleared; Accept-all and Reject-all both dismiss it without console errors. No page/JS errors detected across routes; only dev-mode HMR websocket 502 warnings (harmless, dev server).

issues: Console warns 'Please ensure that the container has a non-static position, like relative/fixed/absolute to ensure scroll offset is calculated correctly.' - likely from Framer Motion useScroll target/container. Non-blocking but should set position on the scroll container to silence.

action_items: (Optional/minor) Silence Framer Motion useScroll warning by ensuring the scroll target/container has non-static position.
(Info) /solutions/network-infrastructure returns 404 by design — actual slugs are cyber-defense, governance-risk-compliance, cybersecurity, ar-vr, ai-for-business, cloud. Not a bug.
critical_code_review_comments: ContactForm posts snake_case field 'full_name' which matches backend Pydantic model — integration verified end-to-end (200).
NEXT_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is correctly derived from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL via next.config.js — external URL used for /api/contact.

All interactive elements have data-testid attributes as required (header-logo, mobile-menu-button, contact-form, input-*, contact-submit-button, contact-success, cookie-consent-banner, cookie-accept-all, cookie-reject-all).
seed_data_creation: One test contact submission POSTed with full_name 'Test User <timestamp>' and email regression@example.com.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Migration to Next.js is stable. Solution detail slugs live under /solutions/[slug] with 6 slugs (cyber-defense, governance-risk-compliance, cybersecurity, ar-vr, ai-for-business, cloud). Backend expects snake_case for /api/contact. Cookie banner uses data-testid=cookie-consent-banner with cookie-accept-all/cookie-reject-all/cookie-customize buttons.
